A patch of weeds; yet flowers bloom vividly in spite of the wretched foliage surrounding them. The struggles of nature create your own personal utopia. A world, tailormade, just for you. Only you.
Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.

Alter your past to reshape your future.

lore: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.
Some places must be protected at all costs. In a frigid, worldwide desert of apathy and ruination, there somehow still remain some oases of love and warmth. Keep them safe, as long as you can.

lore: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

lore: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.
Where thought converges, the veil thins.

lore: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.
An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

lore: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.

The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.
Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.
War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.
The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.

majorIds.Slow Boil: Bakal's Grasp and Enraged Blow have their caps doubled, but Corruption charges 20% as fast.

lore: Lose yourself in the climb.
Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

majorIds.Blinding Lights: All Ophanim orbs deal 250% damage, gain +5 Crystallize per hit, and instead orbit around you. Using Main Attack causes all orbs to travel faster.

lore: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

lore: Exploitation is a game as old as time, but rarely one to be played so transparently. When war reaches your doorstep, though, the facade of civility falls-there is no shame in bleeding an enemy dry.
"Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.
Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.

True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.
Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.
The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.

majorIds.Intangible: The knockback you take is drastically reduced, and reflected damage deals large knockback.

lore: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.

lore: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.

majorIds.Disassociate: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal 30% less damage.

lore: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.
A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...

Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.
The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.
Your disputatious adversaries blanch at your consummate pugnacious ability, and, naturally, your superlative nous.
There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.
You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.

To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?

Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.

majorIds.Solar Wind: Thunderstorm disables Meteor and grants +3 thunderbolts, +3 radius and deal 100% and 110% each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 400% bonus damage.

lore: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

majorIds.Flain Remnants: Destroying a Puppet with Friendly Fire calls forth a Remnant. (Max 5) Each Remnant lasts for 20 seconds, fires an explosive tracking projectile every second that deals 95%, and increases your Main Attack damage by 15%.

lore: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.

Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

This turquoise mask burns into your skin, binding flesh and stone. The flames are a constant reminder of the balance between creation and destruction, and that the fire which sustains can also consume.
The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.

You awake in a cold sweat, finding yourself in control of two more arms and a hard exterior. You cannot make any sense of what is happening inside yourself. You cannot even explain it to yourself. How about you sleep a little bit longer and forget all this nonsense?
Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.

Recovered from subterranean ash deposits, these timeworn greaves are one of many relics of war buried in combat by an ancient eruption. Entombed by millennia of rock and soil, the ideologies of the belligerents have been long forgotten: all that remains is their endless desire for absolution.

majorIds.Desperate Measures: Walk Speed increases by 1% and Jump Height increases by 2% for every 1% hp missing.

lore: You have gotten tired of the abyss staring back. Embrace it in a finale that leaves no survivors.
Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

majorIds.Mob Mentality: Commander places puppets ahead of where you are facing.

lore: A single insect is simple. Perhaps lost, perhaps helpless. But their purpose is immutable over all. If they are to be summoned, then they are to stand. If they are to be asked the impossible, then they are to strike regardless.
A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.

majorIds.Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

lore: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.
This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.
To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.

majorIds.Manic Edge: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

lore: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.
An age of inundation. To overwhelm a vicious hell with immense waves, and protest the hand of fate. To harbor the beginning of life, and nurture a world of growth. From the fire, we are born.

majorIds.Stagnant Air: Air Shout gains doubled area and damage, but is delayed with decreased velocity and hit rate.

lore: The show is about to begin.

Found at the bottom of a hydrothermal trench, this incredibly dense stone has been warped and shifted into the shape of armor, containing the strength of the Earth, its water, and all of its awe-inspiring heat.

The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.
Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.

It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.

majorIds.Bound by Blood: Shadow Projection's teleport range, duration, and launch strength is doubled.

lore: Two sides of the same coin.
To hunt in the Mistwoods is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.

majorIds.Lunge: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

lore: Threaded with strands of silk from a giant moth, it allows the wearer to dash through the air.
A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.

This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

lore: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.
Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.
A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.
The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.
Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.
The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.
Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.
Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-

Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.

majorIds.Chaos Reach: Blood Sorrow spends 20 less points of Blood Pool and inflicts enemies with 0.3 seconds of Bleeding per hit, but no longer grants overhealth.

lore: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

lore: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.

Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.
What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?
Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

majorIds.Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.
A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.

majorIds.Perfect Recall: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

lore: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?

majorIds.Incision Elegy: Lacerate becomes a forward-moving projectile, but no longer lunges.

lore: Just another song and dance.
These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.
I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.
A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.

To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

majorIds.Lockdown: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

lore: The falling sun shall be your demise.

The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.

majorIds.Altruism: Nearby players gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

lore: I am thou... Thou art I.

majorIds.Divine Right: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 60%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 5%.

lore: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.

majorIds.Gunk Shot: Arrow Bomb's velocity is doubled but loses -66% radius and -20% damage.

lore: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.
Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.
Shift after shift, the workers gave everything they had. Quota after quota, even that was not enough. They could only take so much of this before their very spirit was forever broken.

An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.
Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.
He never dies.

majorIds.Fissure: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +275%, and +155%.

lore: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

Your wit picked bare, the raw burn of reality exposing your fresh warped self to the world. Your abilities magnified, a new power ripping free from under your skin. You have traded your mind for something far, far greater.
She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.

majorIds.Napalm: Fire Creep increases Arrow Bomb damage by +15%, but deals 15 times the self-damage and lowers velocity. Scorched Earth radius is increased and deals +65%.

lore: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?

It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

majorIds.Unstable Reaction: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

majorIds.Enlightenment: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana and instead refund 25% of their original cost.

lore: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.
There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?

majorIds.Regicide: Your deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

lore: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.
The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.
A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.
You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.

The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.
There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."

majorIds.Ice Storm: Arrow Shield and Snowstorm's radius' increase by 6 blocks. Arrow Shield's charges are doubled, but no longer give defense.

lore: Whipping, chilling winds, and circling hailstones the size of boulders-the eye of your storm is the only safe place to be.

It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.
Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.
History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

majorIds.Elven Current: Escape can be re-cast twice in mid-air.

lore: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.
Stand up, fight back.

majorIds.Net Shot: Bryophyte Roots is now triggered from Buckshot, doubling its slowness and damage.

majorIds.Wavebreak: Meteor's  damage is replaced by  damage. Psychokinesis can bounce up to 5 times, dealing 100% and 50% area damage, as well as 200% and 100% direct hit damage, increasing by 10% after each bounce. Mana Bank gains 3 less mana from Meteor.

lore: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.

majorIds.Combo Stomp: Landing directly on an enemy with Fierce Stomp sends you back into the air and resets Escape.

majorIds.Lasso: Grappling Hook, War Scream, and Uproot now pull enemies with much more force.

lore: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.

majorIds.Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

lore: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.

majorIds.Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores 5% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

lore: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.

majorIds.Living Museum: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

lore: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.

majorIds.Scarce Comfort: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

lore: Join the fight.

You have seen the worst the world has to offer, and met it with a cold, determined gaze. You kill for those who cannot defend themselves. The battle is everlasting, but you are a durable soldier. Push through; for honour, for glory, for truth.

A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

majorIds.Heroine's Blessing: Devout Union gains +25% damage redirection and +8 radius. Additionally, Enlightenment now only requires 1 broken mantle per mantle given to allies.

lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

majorIds.Lit Fuse: Friendly Fire now works on Totem as well. When Totem's timer runs out, it explodes, firing 5 beams in all directions, each dealing 500%.

lore: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

majorIds.River of Souls: Phantom Ray gains massive radius, but reduced damage by 20%.

lore: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?

majorIds.Flurry of Blows: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

lore: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.

majorIds.Oneself Unto All: Radiance's radius extends 4 blocks beyond Bash and buffs allies with your stats instead of theirs.

lore: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.

majorIds.Starcrossed: Hitting an enemy with Haunting Memory makes it Linked. You can have up to two targets Linked at once. When one Linked enemy takes damage, the other Linked enemy takes that damage as well. Haunted Memory's duration is increased by 5 seconds and its range is increased by 10 blocks.

lore: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.

majorIds.Split Second: Aura now travels faster with Invigorating Wave unlocked, but no longer gives mana.

lore: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.
Break free. Free from the constraints of the flesh, free from the constraints of the mind, free from the constraints of the self.
Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.

majorIds.Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

lore: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.

The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.
A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.

majorIds.Cherry Bombs: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal 100%, 30%, 30%, and 30% instantly.

lore: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.

majorIds.Forest's Blessing: Your hound gains 50% more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by -30%.

lore: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -10%.

lore: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

majorIds.Rock Shield: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

lore: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.
The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.
It is what it is.
Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.

majorIds.Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

lore: Not quite my tempo.
Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.

majorIds.Gruesome Knots: Bleeding and Twisted Tether deal double damage, but Bleeding duration is reduced.

lore: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.
You'll connive, coerce, lure them in and control it all. Until all cards are set, all pieces in place. Then, when they've all exhausted their usefulness...

majorIds.Culicidae Creed: Leap becomes fully vertical, and Spectral Hover lasts twice as long.

lore: Buzzing betwixt the muck and mire.

majorIds.Battlefield Brilliance: Generalist instead makes your next Main Attack deal quadruple damage, followed by a tactical retreat.

lore: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.

Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

lore: The sky knows no bounds.

majorIds.Vedette: Focus gets +10% damage per stack, but caps at 2. Crepuscular Ray can be cast at 2 Focus with decreased Focus drain, launching you into the air and immobilizing you.

lore: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.

As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

majorIds.Twisting Threads: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal 65%. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

lore: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right. Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?
Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure-it will all be worth in the end.

Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .

displayName: Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendary Victory
internalName: Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This perfect-to-the-point-of-indistinguishability replica mask of Herbert von Legendary's face, painstakingly crafted by Corkus's most powerful machines with only the most expensive materials and featuring real moustache hair plucked from Doctor Legendary's face, is desperately handed over to attempt to placate those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession for spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

majorIds.Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

lore: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

majorIds.Lifestream: Blood Sorrow has 4 times the damage and overhealth, but its duration is shortened by 75%.

lore: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

majorIds.Fixate: Distortion decays at a halved rate and Devitalize effects are doubled. However, Distortion effects on abilities are reduced by 40% and Meteor Shower now requires +50% Distortion per Meteor.

lore: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.

Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.
"A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."
Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.
The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

majorIds.Hurricane's Eye: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

lore: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.
Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

A million stinging needles, tangled around your head; A crown of thorns; A wreath of nematocysts; A chaplet of venom and pain. From that poison cup, you drink and drink, until-Like a jellyfish-Only the currents decide your way. Until only an addictive Hate compels you.

Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

majorIds.Divine Honor: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals -15% per hit.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

lore: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

In such a sinister and wicked expanse, one wonders if the best solution is to give up your eyes and replace them with a pair that does not indulge in such evils, cleansing them from your idyllic field of view while the wider world around you withers away.
Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.
A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.

majorIds.Spectral Memory: Ghostly Trigger lasts until landing, but no longer increases attack speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

lore: Your mind is falling apart, the pieces scattering, your grasp on reality weakening, your soul an empty space. I shall fill it.

The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.
Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.
The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

lore: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.

Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.
This relic has been passed down through the ages, from conman to charlatan to chiseller. It grants an inexplicable sense of candor to your words.

displayName: Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory
internalName: Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.
An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion. Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.

This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.
An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.
The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It's naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it's a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.

majorIds.Efflorescence: Serpent's Garden now centers to where you land with Swan Dive. Damage of Swan Dive, Serpent's Garden and Jasmine Bloom are distributed across all elements.

lore: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.
You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.
An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.
This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.

Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.
An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force. Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.

Despite the valley being overtaken by anomalous forces, the toughest flora has managed to avoid extinction. Their coiling vines and roots remind you that even in the most dire of situations, you will never go quietly.

Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplement your failing heart.

lore: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.

The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.

This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

lore: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.

A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself, and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.
This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.

The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?
Made of dark minerals and adorned with pure obsidian, this ornately-crafted helmet is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

lore: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

"How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."

majorIds.Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

lore: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

"In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."
" ."

"The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."

lore: Orders, cannonfire, calls for surrender-the wind carries all. To ride the winds is to harness the lifeblood of battle, infiltrating up the veins of command with mere token resistance.
Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.
It looks like they spelled the name wrong...
Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

majorIds.Forest's Blessing: Your hound gains 50% more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by -30%.

lore: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.
Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

majorIds.Plague: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

lore: Something is lurking-it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains... Are they a reminder of one who didn't stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you're here?

When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.

majorIds.Unstable Reaction: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.
Crystalline towers and stark white horizons. The sharpest frost shards and the softest snowfall. Before the permafrost monarch of winter, lay your heart down: become the right hand of the cold.

majorIds.Altruism: Nearby players gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

lore: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.
An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

majorIds.Madness: Casts a random spell of your class every 3 seconds.

lore: Power, but at what cost?

majorIds.Expunge: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals 15% of your max health.

lore: Those whose souls are lost to the Canyon of the Lost eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.

majorIds.Orbital Chain: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 8000% explosion spell.

lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.
Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.
The spelling seems to have been botched.
If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...
The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

Everything that's fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that's where you come in.
This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.
Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.
A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.

The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.
This dark relic was found at the very bottom of the deepest trench of the ocean. It drains all light surrounding it, blinding everything in a strange abyssal darkness.
450 years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.
A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

A fallen link from a chainmail hauberk of an older time, this ring fell from a giant taller than a mountain. As it sped through the air and gained momentum, it traveled so fast that it was battered to a tenth of its size.

majorIds.Scarce Comfort: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

lore: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so much refuse from the world above.
The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.

majorIds.Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

majorIds.Faustian Gambit: Frog Dance triggers once with increased vertical velocity and knockback, and deals +400%.

lore: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.
This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.
Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.
This item was named by someone from the community!

majorIds.Windsurf: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

lore: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."

Infinitesimal specks of matter wane in and out of view among the darkness of this clasp. Even a glance reminds you of what little exists in the expanses of the Void from which the materials of this were scavenged from.
Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.
Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.

majorIds.Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

majorIds.Divine Honor: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals -15% per hit.

lore: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

majorIds.Freerunner: When your sprint bar is under 30% full, increase your sprint speed by +150%.

lore: Contents under pressure.

majorIds.Alter Ego: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

lore: In the marbling of wood grain. Drying moisture in the cobbles. Clumps of flowers. Tree bark, birth marks, the pattern of this plate - unflinching faces trapped, now revealed. The question pierces your mind: what shape will I be hewn into, one day?

majorIds.Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

lore: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

majorIds.Earthen Splinter: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for 1200%.

lore: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.
An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.

majorIds.Ergosphere: Storm Dance instead lets your Totems pull enemies within their radius. Totem duration is decreased.

lore: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.
The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.
The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

majorIds.Transcendence: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

lore: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

majorIds.Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

lore: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.

Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.

majorIds.Inversion: Teleport will grant you 3 seconds of levitation.

lore: No one can hold you down anymore.

majorIds.Wormhole: Last Laugh instead casts Meteor. Malicious Mockery causes Meteor to apply 13 Trick stacks.

lore: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.
These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

majorIds.Totemic Fuse: Totemic Smash deals +40%, +90%, +90%, and +60% at the cost of half of Totem's duration.

lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

majorIds.Perilous Flare: Pyrokinesis moves much slower, but has an increased Area of Effect and  +50%.

lore: "Discernable by its one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape." -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, 2nd Edition.

Many prophecies foretell of new eras. Most are fabricated or proven false in time. One passed through the Dogun caverns, however, tells of a dawn soon to break, in which the earth shall run red and return to flame. Fanatical sects whisper the coming of a new demonic god.
A pair of glowing sabatons crafted from time-lost relics. Somehow, despite just creating them, you get the feeling that you've worn these before...

The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.

majorIds.Torment Liturgy: Shadow Siphon now immediately refreshes Vanish when triggered, but reduces Surprise Strike's multiplier by -30%.

lore: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.
The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.
When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.
One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

majorIds.Pioneer's Echo: Phantom Ray deals two bursts of  150%,  60% over 1 second. Decimator's increase and cap are raised to 140% and Quick Draw's activation threshold is decreased to 2.

lore: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.
The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

majorIds.Outbreak: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

lore: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

majorIds.Roving Assassin: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.

lore: A relic of the past in Time Valley was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.
"The symbol of the river" is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.
Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.
This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.
This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.
This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.
Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.
This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.
You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.
You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said and every word was true. With this necklace equipped, you could hear the ocean whisper.
You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this ring on your finger, you could catch a gnat without looking.

The masterpiece of a necklace gathers all heat from its surrounding. It is fed to its wearer to maximize the strength of attacks.
The device forged into this flawless ring draws all heat from its surrounding. Though it almost burns, you can feel your abilites enhance.
The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.
The lethal amount of electricity emmited from this often desired necklace fails to kill you, as its pure energy runs through your veins.
The heavy electrical impulses coming from this ring would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is pure power. A true masterpiece of engineering.
This steam-powered bracelet is sought by many challengers of the Legendary Challenge. They say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.
This necklace is the pinnacle of steam-powered technology. Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from the necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all.
Users of this perfect model of Legendary Island's steam-powered ring have reported feeling weightless in combat. The jewel of the ring is a perfectly clear diamond.

Abandoned by the dwarven Ramriders in their heyday, this hefty armor forged to protect a steed sees little use but littering the steppes of the upper heights. A memento of a slaughter, in days long past.

majorIds.Phoenix-Born: Health Regeneration is increased by 0.75% for every 1% Health missing.

lore: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.
Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.
The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.

While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

majorIds.Tidal Drift: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

majorIds.Altruism: Nearby players gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

lore: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.
Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

majorIds.Sun Eater: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

lore: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.

For the belief of the cosmos' defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.
Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.

majorIds.Punishment: Reflected damage blinds enemies for 1s and makes them 10% more vulnerable to attacks for 3s.

lore: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.
In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.

Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.
Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.
