A single vibrant star sits at the focus of the mirror. Though, faintly, many more sit in the perimeter of the view... perhaps they mean something?
Elementally attuned gemstones are melded together to form the singular marvel found on this pendant. Despite the violent smithing process, the jewel is utterly flawless.
An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.

Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.
I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

lore: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...

majorIds.Three Bodies: Pressure grants additional effects: Bash gains +4 radius, Uppercut gains +75%, and War Scream's buff gains +12s duration

lore: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.

Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

majorIds.Coagulate: Blood Connection and Eldritch Call's teleports launch you further and higher.

majorIds.Space Glide: Lacerate performs a single horizontal jump and slash, dealing 400%.

lore: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...

Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.

Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

majorIds.Grand Influence: While above 80% maximum health, nearby allies gain 15% increased health gain from all sources and 25% Walk Speed.

lore: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

majorIds.Hawkeye: Arrow Hurricane becomes a condensed stream of 25 arrows, dealing 45%, 6%, and 6% each.

lore: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.
The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.

Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.
Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.

The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.
This item was named by someone from the community!

Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

majorIds.Guardian: Devout Union gains +20% damage redirection and +4 radius.

lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.
Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

majorIds.Gruesome Knots: Bleeding and Twisted Tether deal double damage, but Bleeding duration is reduced.

lore: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?
Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.
Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

Life itself is not a flexible material to work with-building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.
Two iron horns adorn this helmet to enhance the warriors of the Eradian, Dwarves who specifically rode Rams into battle at incredible speed.

majorIds.Reality Revision: Phasing Beam instead makes Twain's Arc explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing its damage in a 5 block radius. Twain's Arc now has extreme recoil.

lore: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.

Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

majorIds.Lunge: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

lore: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.

Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.
This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.
All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

lore: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.

...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from Aldorei Medical Tomes, Vol. 6
Perennial, in a sense-these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.

majorIds.Sublimation: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

majorIds.Saviour's Sacrifice: While under 50% maximum health, nearby allies gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

lore: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.
Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

majorIds.Soul Eater: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

lore: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in Cinfras. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.

majorIds.Cosmic Capture: Meteor falls twice as fast, has +3 blast radius, and pulls enemies upon impact.

lore: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.
This small, rough-crafted pendant is the only known magic artifact of the Orcs. It incites destructive tendencies within the wearer.

majorIds.Reckless Abandon: Sacrifice War Scream's defense bonus to give Tempest +5%, +15%, 5% and 3 extra hits.

lore: A condition of severely deficient supply of oxygen to the body that arises from abnormal breathing; practitioners that abuse specific magic combos are often found incapacitated by said condition.

majorIds.Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

One of the very few physically-powerful artifacts of the Villagers, these boots were used in the initial crusades against the Green-skins, to overpower the Orcs via raw physical might. Though effective, they have not seen use in a long time.
A lost relic from the Wind Fortress, a mythical stronghold of the Sky Islands that fell into the Void long ago. A small mechanism within the bracelet points towards its place of origin.
The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

majorIds.Transcendence: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.
Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...

From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.
They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

A silhouette of forgotten strength, its essence lingering like a half remembered dream. It no longer boasts the sharpness it once had, yet the stories etched into its very being refuse to fade.

Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.

All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore. These memories exist in the hearts of all, and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace, however rocky that path may be.

lore: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.

Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...
The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.
The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.
This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the Detlas square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.

Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in Gelibord as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.

Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.
Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.
One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.
One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.
They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.
"After the Nivla forest fire, I'm glad the corrupteds haven't thought to try and burn the Detlas Suburbs." -Sergeant Klafson, Detlas Legion

The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.
An uncountably old relic of Time Valley which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
Quick, over there!
The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

lore: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, Nemract Militia
...It's pulling towards something.
"We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion
"Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher
These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to Mt. Wynn. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.
Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places. A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.
"They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher
"I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits
"With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner
"The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest
It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.
"Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia
"And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller
The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.
Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.
"The skeletons at Ancient Nemract are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, Nemract Librarian
"With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from Nesaak, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, Elkurn Citizen
"Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, Time Valley Resident
"The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, Saint's Row Priest
Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.
...It's pulling towards something.
Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.
It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.
This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of Ancient Nemract before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for Nemract's guard.
...It's pulling towards something.
Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.
"Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript
Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.
There used to be a constant battle between Almuj's thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.
...It's pulling towards something.
Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.
One of Detlas' buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the Durum Isles.
...It's pulling towards something.
"Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.
Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.

The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.
"We get a lot of weirdos coming from Gavel by airship. That plate mail looked unusably ornate!" -Calo, Private Airship Operator
They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.
Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.
...It's pulling towards something.
"I just need a little more spider silk to finish this vest!" -Lacrona, Detlas Tailor, found eaten by Nivla spiders
Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.
A centuries-old storm spirit was banished to these tight boots for his destructive actions. His fury empowers those who wear them with the great force of a raging cyclone.
Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.
"Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer
"If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion
"I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

"...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3
The reigning king of thieves in Almuj's underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.

A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.
...It's pulling towards something.
"I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher
This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.

"You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division
"And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

Nothing stands out about these thin greaves at a glance. But sometimes, when the time is right, a tempestuous power rushes through them: your legs moving as by themselves, and taking leaps that they should never be able to.
"Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident
"I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant
"The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

"...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3
Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.
Due to an unfortunate accident where he choked on a lemon, an unremarkable mercenary became a laughing stock. He later managed to shed the title, as he left no one alive who remembered the name.
Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.
The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.
"Crawly things. They crawl on the mushrooms. Mushrooms shouldn't be crawly!" -Yahya, Mushroom Man
"I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher
Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

"...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3
...It's pulling towards something.

The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.
These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.
Plated with enchanted metals, these magic-warding boots allow faster travel over nearly any solid surface.
A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.
Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.
The one true Chimera in existence is sought by many, for great stories are told of its gifts to the worthy. One such gift was a simple fur coat, which gave the wearer but a taste of its power.
The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.
A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.
This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.
"...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan
An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.
Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.
"My dear boy should never have to go through the horrors of losing a mother like that." -Momo, adoptive mother of Bob
It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.
This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.
Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.
A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.
Made of an uncommonly used fabric called denim, these fashionable leggings exude style and elegance. Surely wearing them would bring you luck?
"I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort
...It's pulling towards something.
A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

"The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen
Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.
"I thought aiming for the legs would disable the enemy. Turns out they can drag themselves with their arms just as quick." -Therck, Ragni Soldier 3rd Division
"There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

The forger of this ring had to endure 30 long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
"Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier
This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.
This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.
"Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni
This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.
"As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer
Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.

Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
The thick, Bovemist-sanctified cloth is worn by their priests during certain religious ceremonies. It clears the mind and purifies the body.
The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.
Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.
Despite being only an impure scrap of the normally sturdy blackiron, these heavy leggings still have extreme defensive capabilities.
